name: oti-domain-intelligence
description: Look up any domain: WHOIS/RDAP registration, DNS, the live SSL certificate, live subdomains with IPs, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC. Includes skills for phishing triage, email-security audits and domain due diligence.

rapidapi_key.title: RapidAPI key (optional)
rapidapi_key.description: Leave empty to use the free allowance (1,000 lookups a month, no key). To use your own plan instead, paste a RapidAPI key subscribed to the Domain Intelligence API.
